# cassandra_keyspace (Resource)

Manages a Cassandra keyspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cassandra_keyspace" "simple" {
  name                 = "app"
  replication_strategy = "SimpleStrategy"
  strategy_options = {
    replication_factor = 1
  }
}

resource "cassandra_keyspace" "multi_dc" {
  name                 = "app_multi_dc"
  replication_strategy = "NetworkTopologyStrategy"
  strategy_options = {
    dc1 = 3
    dc2 = 3
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the keyspace, 1 to 48 characters.
- `replication_strategy` (String) Replication strategy: `SimpleStrategy` or `NetworkTopologyStrategy`.
- `strategy_options` (Map of String) Options for the replication strategy. `SimpleStrategy` takes `replication_factor`; `NetworkTopologyStrategy` takes data center names mapped to their replication factor.

### Optional

- `durable_writes` (Boolean) Enable durable writes. Disabling them is not recommended. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the keyspace.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cassandra_keyspace.simple app
```
